messages:
sam: Heads-up  partner sent a manifest correction. Looks like 100 units we were promised are double-booked.
tasha: Double-booked? Which reservation IDs and affected customers?
supply-bot: Manifest correction: reservations [RC-21001, RC-21002] originally total 220 units. Current status: RC-21001 -> 120 units (our allocation), RC-21002 -> 100 units flagged 'conflict' in partner ledger. Carrier note: 'hold pending invoice reconcile'.
leo: That 100 conflict hits NovaEdge (60 GPUs, GA demo 2026-08-02) and our SI proof-of-value pool (40 GPUs). NovaEdge SLA contains a delivery-readiness clause.
atalie: If we miss NovaEdge demo it hurts the co-marketing announcement. Ops options: (1) push partner to release after invoice reversal, (2) airfreight 100 units to our dock, (3) short-burst marketplace for 60 and borrow partner test-pool for 40.
legal: External comms: "We're validating a partner inventory update and enacting mitigations to maintain your launch schedule." Avoid numbers and promises about credits.
sam: @tasha can you open finance channel with PartnerX? Ask for immediate PO reversal or release note. Also request Bill of Lading and carrier contact.
tasha: On it. Sending finance release template and escalation to PartnerX AE now.
supply-bot: PartnerX reply: they can release 40 units immediately after PO reversal; remaining 60 are invoiced to a different buyer and can be airfreighted in 48h at surcharge.
leo: Ok so immediate 40 + airfreight 60(48h) = covers NovaEdge in 48h but demo is 72h out. We still need 60 GPUs now to guarantee parity for the GA demo.
natalie: Marketplace route: we can short-burst 60 A100-class for ~7 days. Cost uplift ~2.5x. Ops provisioning ~8-12h. Alternatively, borrow partner test-pool 40 and marketplace 20. Mixed-SKU risk for GA demo.
legal: If mixed-SKU for GA, document in writing and run a 2-hour smoke validation; include a brief customer notice about 'hardware variance for parity testing'.
sam: Decision: pursue immediate 40 release + marketplace 60 while continuing invoice reversal and surcharge negotiation. @tasha confirm finance release and ask PartnerX for surcharge concession. @leo kick off marketplace procurement request. @natalie prep customer-facing mitigation note.
tasha: Finance sent release note and asked PartnerX to confirm within 2 hours. Also requested invoice copy and counterparty info.
leo: Marketplace request submitted for 60 units; provisioning ETA ~10h. I'll tag infra to prioritize.
supply-bot: Update: PartnerX confirmed release of 40 units and uploaded BOL to the ticket. Airfreight still requires PO acceptance.
natalie: Draft to NovaEdge (hold): "We identified a partner inventory update. We're enacting mitigations (temporary reallocation + short-term capacity) to keep your GA demo on schedule. We'll share an update within 6 hours and a support runbook for the demo." Legal ok?
legal: Wording ok. Do not commit to credits. Offer on-call support and a follow-up postmortem.
leo: Quick ops note: mixed-SKU parity smoke will need driver bundles and a 90-minute end-to-end test. We can run that once marketplace units are provisioned.
tasha: PartnerX replied: they will absorb 40% of the airfreight surcharge as concession if we accept PO now. They've also started invoice reconciliation for the 60 flagged units.
sam: Negotiation accepted. Approving PO for airfreight with concession. Finance to record concession and invoice offsets.
tasha: PO approved and sent. PartnerX confirmed airfreight 60 units ETA 2026-07-30 03:00 UTC (within SLA window).
supply-bot: Status: 40 released on site, 60 airfreight in transit, marketplace 60 provisioning in progress.
leo: Marketplace 60 provisioning complete and smoke tests scheduled for the next 2 hours. Will post results.
leo: (2h later) Smoke tests passed. Demo parity validated across mixed SKUs.
natalie: Sent mitigation note to NovaEdge with runbook and on-call schedule. They acknowledged and appreciate the proactive plan.
legal: Keep manifest, BOLs, and concession emails for the supplier claim. We'll coordinate any SLA remedy conversation offline.
sam: Closing loop. Postmortem scheduled after GA. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
